subject: AcroLabs private deploy: bundle structure, amortized platform fee, and support tiers
messages:

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment proposal and bundle outline

Hi Elena — great to run through the architecture review this morning. As discussed, attached is a starting commercial bundle for a VPC/private deployment: SOW (ACRO_SOW_v1.pdf) and a line-item pricing workbook (redwood_privdeploy_pricing_sheet.xlsx).

Quick highlights:
- Committed nodes: 8 GPU nodes (A100 equivalent) mapped to the 24/7 inference cluster
- Platform fee: quoted as a single annual platform fee; we can discuss amortization over the contract term
- Support: Standard (business hours) included; Premium SRE add-on with 24/7 on-call and 1-hr P1 SLA as a paid tier

Next asks from your side:
1) Target committed term (12 vs 24 months)
2) Desired support response SLA and on-call coverage
3) Any procurement or signatory constraints we should know about

I cc'ed Marissa (AE) and Aditya (solutions) to help shape the commercial options. We can do a narrow counter with two concession paths once you share term preference.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Elena Grover <elena.grover@acrolabs.com>

Date: 2026-09-04T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment proposal and bundle outline

Marcus — thanks for the deck and the call.

A few clarifying items from procurement and our infra team:
- Term: we are inclined toward a 24-month committed term but need to see how pricing scales at breakpoints (12 / 24 / 36 months).
- Platform fee: can Redwood amortize the platform fee over the committed term (vs invoicing up-front)? If not, can you propose a partial amortization or implementation credit?
- Support tiers: we expect production SLAs comparable to cloud providers — 1-hr P1, 4-hr P2, and a dedicated SRE retainer. Need visibility into what Redwood includes vs what is add-on.
- Security/compliance: we will push a SOC2 attestation clause into the SOW; please confirm you can provide the evidence during procurement review.

Procurement also asked for a couple of commercial alternatives: a) deeper node discount for longer terms, or b) keep list pricing but provide an implementation credit and extended onboarding hours.

If you can send two concrete options (pricing + invoicing cadence + support scope) we can take to legal/procurement next week.

Best,
Elena
Elena Grover
VP Infrastructure, AcroLabs
elena.grover@acrolabs.com

Elena — thanks, that is helpful. Looping Naomi (pricing) to build two crisp commercial options and clarify amortization mechanics.

Naomi / Marissa — AcroLabs is asking for two alternatives: (A) term-driven node discount or (B) list nodes + implementation credit + extended onboarding. They also want platform fee amortization options and explicit support SLA descriptions. Please see the attached pricing sheet and suggest two offer bundles we can present.

Goal: get a paper-ready option set this week so Acro can route to procurement/legal next Monday.

Marcus

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-05T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment proposal and bundle outline

Team — drafted two commercial options for AcroLabs. Summaries below (see pricing workbook for math):

Option 1 — Term-breakpoint discount (preferred if they want simple invoicing)
- 24-month commit: 18% off list per-node rate (vs 12-month baseline)
- 36-month commit: 25% off list per-node rate
- Platform fee: invoiced annually; offer ability to prepay for multiple years at contract signature (no amortization on our books), but provide a 6-month implementation credit for migrations (applied as a one-time invoice credit $40,000)
- Support: Premium SRE add-on priced as monthly retainer ($18k/mo) which includes 24/7 on-call; P1 1-hr, P2 4-hr, runbooks and monthly run-rate review

Option 2 — Fixed node price + amortized platform fee (preferred for procurement teams wanting capex smoothing)
- Node pricing: list - 10% (no term breakpoints)
- Platform fee: Redwood amortizes 50% of the platform fee over the contract term (Redwood invoices 50% up-front and spreads remaining 50% equally across the term monthly invoicing)
- Implementation credit: one-time onboarding credit of $25,000 applied against the first invoice
- Support: include a limited SRE retainer (business hours + on-call escalation windows) with upgrade path to Premium at a discounted rate for contract term

Key tradeoffs to call out to AcroLabs:
- Option 1 gives deeper node-level savings for longer-term commitments but keeps platform fee handling simple (prepay or annual invoice). Good for teams that prefer predictable unit economics.
- Option 2 smooths cash flow for Acro (amortized platform fee) with a smaller node discount. It is slightly more complex operationally for Redwood accounting but often wins with procurement.

Attachments: implementation-credit-summary.pdf (PDF summary of credit mechanics)

Marissa — I left a cell for a DocuSign-ready amendment and SOW changes; happy to walk through with you.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Pricing, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
